subject: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — renegotiation & options
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@artifactvault.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — initial check-in

Hi Sarah,

We're coming up on the ArtifactVault contract renewal for our CI and registry bundles (term ends 2026-06-30). I pulled the usage export and attached a short CSV — please see `usage_report_may2026.csv`. Before we loop in procurement, I need a clear, line-item view for the following so we can align budget and technical scope: 

- License coverage: how Buildkite agent licenses (we run many Buildkite pipelines) map to your product SKUs vs. CircleCI if we choose to test/transition.
- Registry add-ons: which features in our current plan are billed as separate add-ons (e.g., geo-replication, storage-tiering, retention policies) and what the marginal cost looks like at current usage + 20% growth.
- Any new usage-based fees (egress, manifest scans) introduced in the last 12 months and their typical per-month impact.

Target timeline: we want a vendor quote and recommended options by EOD 2026-05-11 so procurement can start the contract/redline cycle the week of 2026-05-18. If you need more info from engineering (e.g., exact concurrent agent counts, retention windows), please call that out — I've copied Dev and Karthik.

Proposed times for a quick 30-min sync: 2026-05-10 between 10:00-11:30 PT or 2026-05-11 14:00-16:00 PT.

Thanks,

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: usage_report_may2026.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@artifactvault.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: registry-support@harborcloud.com
Date: 2026-05-10T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — initial check-in

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear ask and the usage export. Quick summary below, and I'm attaching a preliminary quote (artifactvault_prelim_quote_20260510.pdf).

Summary (high level):
- License mapping: Buildkite agents are licensed per-concurrent-agent under our "Pipeline Pro" SKU; CircleCI would map to our "Orchestrate" SKU — pricing differs mainly on concurrency vs seat models. At your current concurrency (quoted in the CSV) our recommended SKU remains Pipeline Pro.
- Registry add-ons: geo-replication and storage-tiering are billed as add-ons. Based on your current storage profile, geo-replication would add ~8% to monthly spend; storage-tiering can reduce egress costs but is an incremental fee.
- New fees: we surfaced a minor per-manifest scan fee (introduced 2026-01) — for your repo profile that's currently ~$450/month.

I've included two commercial options in the quote: 12-month committed (better blended rate) and 24-month committed (larger discount, includes 1 free geo-replication node for year 1). Both include details on the Buildkite concurrency bands.

Suggested next step: review the attached quote and confirm which term you want (12 vs 24). I can prepare an initial SOW and return a redline-ready contract after we agree on term and scope. I'm available 2026-05-10 10:00 PT for the 30-min sync if that still works.

Regards,
Sarah Nguyen
Account Executive, ArtifactVault
sarah@artifactvault.com
Attachments: artifactvault_prelim_quote_20260510.pdf (PDF, 68KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@artifactvault.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — initial check-in

Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from engineering and procurement copied in: 

Dev / Karthik: can you confirm two things so we can give Sarah a clear signal?
1) Peak concurrent Buildkite agents during heavy rollout windows (we think ~220 but CSV had intermittent peaks).
2) Retention window for images that require geo-replication; if we narrow which namespaces need replication we can reduce the cost.

Procurement (Marissa): our budget ask right now is to keep run-rate increases under 12% YoY. If we must go higher for 24-mo commitments to get a discount, we need the net present cost comparison and the break-even horizon.

Sarah — tentative preference is to aim for the 12-month committed band unless the 24-month savings clearly offset the risk. Please include a per-feature line that shows costs both with and without the new manifest-scan fee so procurement can evaluate. Also include sample contract clauses for data residency and audit logs; our security team will want to review.

I'll take the 10:00 PT sync.

— Lauren
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@artifactvault.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-05-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — contract/redline prep

Folks — moving this into procurement track. A few items Procurement needs before we'll sign: 

- Contract redlines (standard) attached: `redline_ArtifactVault_contract.docx`. Please review the following must-haves: 30-day SLA credits, CPI-based egress caps, and audit log retention 13 months (we prefer 24, but we can compromise).
- Invoice timing: we need monthly invoices with itemized lines for add-ons; one-time setup fees require PO approval.
- Data residency: any geo-replication nodes that hold EU data must remain in EU regions (if we elect geo-replication for those namespaces).

Marissa will lead negotiations on pricing. Sarah — would you accept the redlines for the 12-month term and then we can negotiate discounts separately? If you can return a redline-accepted contract and a final quote by EOD 2026-05-12, procurement can issue PO the following week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redline_ArtifactVault_contract.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@artifactvault.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CI license coverage + registry add-ons — contract/redline prep

Marissa / Lauren — thanks for the redlines and the clear timeline. Quick update: 

- We reviewed your redlines and accepted SLA credits and itemized monthly invoices; we proposed minor language edits to the egress caps to align with our operations team. Full tracked changes are uploaded to the renewal portal (link below).
- Attached: `invoice_AV-2026-05-12.pdf` for your records.
- Commercial terms: we can do the 12-month committed term with a 10% blended discount across Buildkite concurrency bands and waive the one-time geo-replication setup fee. We will include an option page for a 24-month term that brings the blended discount to 16% with the free geo-replication node for year 1.

Action items:
- Lauren / Dev: confirm peak concurrency number today (Dev reply will suffice).
- Marissa: I'll upload the redline-accepted contract and send a DocuSign link once you confirm PO internal approvals.
- Sarah: propose to finalize DocuSign by 2026-05-18.

DocuSign link (vendor portal): https://app.artifactvault.com/docusign/DL-2026-078
Renewal portal: https://app.artifactvault.com/account/renewals/DL-2026-078
